scope: Finite host model over target OF helper behavior; it is not an unbounded proof of all possible device-tree contents and does not substitute for device validation.
comparisons: Stock behavioral model vs. actual reconstructed C: object bytes, log sequence, OF call sequence and counts.

counterexample.seeded_mutation: Change duration_time commit from aw+0x464 to aw+0x465.

limitations: This is a finite host model, not an unbounded formal proof.

The stock behavioral model and candidate share the OF helper stubs. Target OF errno and write semantics are independently anchored to the exact Docker kernel source contract; the harness validates parser reactions to those results.
